mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days without regime-specific conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances with FEDFUNDS < 3.5% during monetary easing cycles, or mean return difference from baseline is not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeding 0.3% signals accelerating inflation, triggering Fed tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances with CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%, or mean return difference from baseline is not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline signal labor market overheating, accelerating inflation expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances with PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion regimes with HOUST > 1500 thousand units signal overvaluation and impending policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances during late-cycle expansion with HOUST > 1500, or mean return difference from baseline is not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS above 200-day moving average) indicate robust consumer spending, supporting earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances with RSAFS above 200-day moving average, or mean return difference from baseline is not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO monthly decline below zero signals economic weakening, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days due to immediate risk-off sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances with INDPRO monthly change < 0, or mean return difference from baseline is not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS increase and UNRATE < 4% signal aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances with FEDFUNDS increase and UNRATE < 4%, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Recessionary conditions (INDPRO decline) trigger deteriorating earnings and risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances during recessionary conditions (INDPRO decline), or mean return difference from baseline is not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).
